notes: Tail case. U1 mask is the blindfolded performer's white shirt; ref named a person -> shirt, and the edit is now a structural replace (shirt -> sleeveless leather vest) so the case keeps a replace after U2's recolor became an attribute. U2 red flag -> yellow attribute (no natural structural replacement). U3 orange bicycle re-segmented (v2) to exclude grass inside wheels and the blue jacket draped on it. U4 helmet ref made precise.
